_comment: MECHA-FORGE asset roster for Meshy v6 (text-to-3D, textured PBR). Each -> textured GLB -> bake_meshy.py -> game sprite. Prompts kept single-subject, hard-surface, neutral standing pose for a clean top-down 3/4 bake. Run the hero FIRST, judge, then the rest.
